lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating defined anchor nodes along the lateral axis.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with high-luminance values on the dorsal edge and dark shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density of high-luminance circular blobs scattered across the leading edge and central surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral region near the base of the visible pectoral fin.
